Name: TheBigBankPhone
Author: Veldorae
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Pelican Town Pack is two mods that work together. Cell Phone (Cep Telefonu) is a phone that opens in the bottom-right corner with the P key, built from the game's own menu frames and item art. Your calendar, birthdays, the Help Wanted board, mail, weather, animals and TV fit in your pocket. Pelican Bank (Pelikan Bankası) puts a JojaBank ATM in the town square: your money earns interest, your earnings are taxed, and passing out no longer empties your wallet. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Installation 1. Install SMAPI (4.0 or later). 2. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings. 3. Unzip and put the CepTelefonu and PelikanBankasi folders into the game's Mods folder. 4. Launch the game through SMAPI. Phone: P. ATM: in the square next to Pierre's shop (from day 4). [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Cell Phone Drawn with the game's own UI; opens bottom-right without dimming the game. Apps are bought cheaply from the phone's Store. Open the letters in your mailbox from the phone; the mailbox marker on the farm disappears too. Accept the Help Wanted job without walking to town. Birthdays, favorite gifts, festivals and your animals' status in one place. Pocket TV: weather, fortune teller, Livin' Off The Land, Queen of Sauce (watching teaches the recipe). Battery indicator = your energy. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Pelican Bank A JojaBank ATM in the town square, next to Pierre's shop. Announcement letter on day 3, installed on day 4. When Joja closes, Pierre takes it over and it turns green. Daily interest with withholding tax. Progressive income tax on daily earnings. No money lost when passing out at night or in the mines. Mobile banking on the phone; cash withdrawals only at the ATM [/color]

Manifest.Name: Cep Telefonu
Manifest.Description: A cell phone drawn with the game's own UI, opened with P in the bottom-right corner: calendar, contacts, quests, mail, weather, animals, TV and bank. Remote chests and cheats can be enabled in the settings. English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Русский.
Manifest.Author: Veli

Manifest.Name: Pelikan Bankası
Manifest.Description: A JojaBank ATM in the town square, mobile banking on the phone, daily interest, withholding tax and progressive income tax. No money lost when you pass out. English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Русский.
Manifest.Author: Veli
